top_signals.title: How bad has the ‘cost of living crisis’ really been?
top_signals.summary: The 'cost of living crisis' has become a well-worn phrase over the last four years, but what do the numbers actually say, asks Paul Ormerod.

top_signals.title: These are the two things holding back housebuilding
top_signals.summary: Falling consumer confidence and severe development unviability are hindering housebuilding. We need a comprehensive strategy including regulatory freezes, a shared equity scheme, and planning reforms to tackle the housing crisis, says Gavin Barwell Everybody knows there is a housing crisis – it has been building for the last 50 years.
